thread:
mia: FYI saw a customer ticket where a WS stream silently closed, client reconnected and we ended up charging twice for the same conversation. :facepalm:
ryan: ouch. any traces or headers?
mia: trace=trc_b1c2, sample logs: `conn_id=cid-77 closed without FIN`, then `new_conn=cid-78 resume: true`
pat: hmm. our billing currently keys on conn_id + tenant. if the client opens a brand new socket we lose the tie to prior billing event.
linh: can we include a persistent session id in the wire protocol? e.g. `X-Stream-Session: s-772` sent on initial open and on resume. billing-ingest can dedupe on session+tenant.
ryan: session id sounds good but risk of collision or replay attacks. require HMAC-namespace: `session_id = base64(hmac(tenant_key, ephemeral))` so only edge can validate.
pat: agree. for short term we could implement a best-effort dedupe in billing by looking for identical (tenant, model, prompt-hash) within 90s window and label as "possible-dup". console will show possible-dup flag so ops can decide.
mia: short-term approach would unblock support ticket quickly. long-term: add session header + an explicit `stream_resume: true` frame so downstream knows this is a continuation, not a fresh request.
linh: for telemetry, emit `stream_event: open|resume|close|fragment` and attach `route_hint` so we can correlate with routing flips. then console correlation view can surface routing-change overlays on billing spikes.
ryan: note: we should be conservative with memory in billing-ingest. TTL resume keys to 3m max and store only hashes. use bloom filter for fast approx dedupe at high throughput.
pat: also propose an alert: if >0.2% of billed streams in 5m are tagged possible-dup, page eng-platform. that catches rollout regressions.
mia: ops ask: can we toggle dedupe logic with a feature flag? we want to canary on 5% of traffic for 2h.
linh: yes, feature flag `ws_dedupe_session` ready. will queue canary.
deploy-bot: scheduled flag rollout: ws_dedupe_session -> canary 5% starting 2026-03-22T09:10Z.
ryan: follow-ups: add an e2e test that simulates opaque proxy close, resume, and assert billed_tokens_delta == 0. add console UX ticket for correlation timeline and tooltip explaining "possible duplicate charge".
mia: thanks team. I'll paste the raw trace and a minimal repro script in this thread in a bit. :thumbsup:
notes: Discusses websocket silent close causing duplicate billing, proposes session header, short-term heuristic dedupe, telemetry tags, feature-flagged canary, alerts, and console correlation UX. Contains small log and header snippets and deploy-bot message.
